title.narrative: Youth Collective Action for Social Transformation in Zimbabwe

description.narrative: The overall objective is to strengthen local Civil Society Organisations (CSOs) engagement as actors of good governance and development in Zimbabwe. More specifically, the Action will strengthen the capacity of youth organisations, including organisations for young people with disabilities, to engage in policy dialogue sub-national and national levels and , to enhance creativity and innovation among young women and men, including those with disabilities.
